correctness.rationale: The five exclusive local equality cases are exhaustive over all 240 nonpalindromic four-tuples. Their explicit potential inequality sums through exact triple-flow balance. At each of four aaa vertices, reversal exclusion plus flow parity forces the uniform-edge count <=2, yielding the universal 90+16=106 bound. The 106-digit cyclic witness was independently parsed and all cyclic windows/reversals enumerated with an executable standard-library checker. Both halves establish exact maximality.
